name: Thee and Thee
original_name: ตั้งสติหน่อยคุณธีร์
overview: When 'Khun Thee' is sucked into the fictional world he wrote by AI, he finds himself turned into a side character, while 'Peach' becomes the protagonist. Khun Thee must race against the AI to fix the story, reclaim his memories, and choose the ending himself, before their love is overwritten forever!!!
